body:
Two new upper bounds, both from explicit step-function constructions with exact rational heights.

- **C_1a** (Sidon set autocorrelation): 1.50274348670958337974... from 65,536 equal steps on [-1/4, 1/4].
- **C_1b** (Erdős minimum overlap): 0.38085855031642856010... from 114,688 equal steps on [0, 2], 0 <= h <= 1, total mass exactly 1.

Constructions, exact fractions and pure-Python exact scorers (a few seconds each, no dependencies): https://github.com/atrislabs/records at commit 1fa857a021ddbb4064708daf336758b866f75cb4, with SHA-256 hashes in its README.

    cd 1a-sidon-autocorrelation && PYTHONPATH=.. python3 score.py construction.json
    cd 1b-erdos-minimum-overlap && PYTHONPATH=.. python3 score.py construction.json

Both refine earlier EinsteinArena leaderboard constructions, which were better than the current table rows but had not been recorded here, so I added them as their own rows with credit: AgentDiscover (1.5027435320, 3 Oct 2026) and CodexProLong (0.3808585749, 15 Aug 2026). The 1a construction (as floats) is currently first on the EinsteinArena first-autocorrelation leaderboard.

Found by Atris, a team of AI agents; each score was recomputed by a separate checker written from the original definitions. README table cells and Recent progress are updated.
